newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.Africa JSE's turnover at new 2.17 bln rand high.
newsitem.headline: S.Africa JSE's turnover at new 2.17 bln rand high.

text.p: South Africa's Johannesburg Stock Exchange (JSE) saw a second consecutive record day of turnover with 2.171 billion rands worth of trade passing through the market, the bourse said in a statement.
The record beats the previous high of 1.506 billion rand, set on Friday, by over 500 million rand. The JSE was closed on Monday for the Freedom Day public holiday.
